Description: The calculator emits moment_of_inertia with dimension area_moment and section_modulus with dimension volume. The section schema allows area_moment but not volume, while PKG-02 units/model schemas do not accept area_moment, volume_per_length, or mass_per_length. The calculator/schema/unit contracts are therefore not mutually compatible.
ProposedDisposition: Align section output dimensions with DEL-02-02 and the section schema, then add a test that validates calculator outputs against the accepted schema/units vocabulary. Stage 2 technical evidence: core/section_properties/calculator.py now emits second_moment_area for moment_of_inertia/torsional_constant, section_modulus for section_modulus, volume_per_length, and mass_per_length. tests/test_section_properties.py asserts calculator output dimensions are canonical.

Description: Calculator input Quantity.provenance is optional and _validate_quantity does not require or preserve input provenance. Library-sourced or imported values can therefore be calculated without a finding for missing provenance, despite DEL-02-01 and DEL-03-08 provenance expectations.
ProposedDisposition: Require provenance for library/imported inputs or add an explicit source classification that produces provenance diagnostics when needed. Stage 2 technical evidence: Quantity now requires provenance at construction/mapping boundaries, and _validate_quantity emits SECTION_PROVENANCE_MISSING when input provenance is absent.

Description: SectionDiagnostic reports code, severity, field, message, and remediation, but does not carry PKG-02 diagnostic class, source, affected object, or provenance. Calculator failures are explicit, but not yet full DEL-02-03/DEL-02-05 result-envelope diagnostics.
ProposedDisposition: Map SectionDiagnostic into the PKG-02 diagnostic/result-envelope structure before solver, persistence, or report integration. Stage 2 technical evidence: SectionDiagnostic now carries diagnostic_class, source, affected_object, and provenance. tests/test_section_properties.py asserts the generated diagnostic envelope fields on blocking calculator diagnostics.
